events.title: EPC postpones the unstructured-address end date
events.summary: The EPC removed the 15 November 2026 end date. A replacement date has not been set.

events.title: Swift defers the structured-address requirement
events.summary: Swift deferred its November 2026 payments changes. It said it would consult on the structured-address timing and provide an update by December 2026 at the latest.

events.title: Swiss Payments keeps the 14 November 2026 transition
events.summary: SPS 2026 remains scheduled for 14 November 2026, including pain.001.001.09 and structured or hybrid address requirements. SIX says SIC address validation will be waived to avoid hindering payments routed to or from Swift.

events.title: Fedwire moves the November 2026 release to November 2027
events.summary: The release moved to November 2027. The exact date is to be announced. Hybrid addresses are planned to be supported with that release.

events.title: Bank of England delays the November 2026 RTGS standards release
events.summary: The Bank delayed the November 2026 release, including CHAPS messaging standards, to maintain alignment with Swift. The announcement did not give a replacement date.

events.title: German industry suspends the November 2026 retirement of legacy formats
events.summary: The German Banking Industry Committee suspended the planned retirement of older SEPA, foreign-transfer, and euro-urgent-transfer formats. New end dates will follow Swift and EPC decisions.
